creator: brandnat
title: Five CLAUDE.md tips attributed to Claude Code's creator at the Opus 5 launch: delete old instructions every 6 months, start fresh per model, add rules only after repeated mistakes, give goal/guardrails/success criteria, stop micromanaging

tools.name: Claude Opus 5
tools.detail: tips framed around the Opus 5 launch interview

claims: Claude Code's creator said in an interview at the Opus 5 launch that you should delete your CLAUDE.md
Tip 1: delete old instructions every six months
Tip 2: start fresh with every new model because each model behaves differently
Tip 3: only add rules after a repeated mistake
Tip 4: give it goals, guardrails and success criteria (creator says this one has not changed)
Tip 5: stop micromanaging; tell it to do the thing instead of listing 20 steps
Old instructions from 6 months ago may be what is holding a capable model back
how_to_steps: Back up your current CLAUDE.md somewhere in case the leaner version performs worse
Delete stale instructions (creator suggests a six-month cadence) and start fresh when a new model ships
Only re-add a rule after Claude repeats the same mistake
Write the goal, guardrails and success criteria rather than step-by-step procedures
Retry harder problems the old setup could not solve with fewer prompts and compare
